correctness.rationale: The centered generator-coordinate laws are sign-reflection symmetric in both sampling models; the pair-difference squared distance equals A+cJ, with (A,J) invariant under J sign reversal. Symmetric spread is monotone for every convex test, strictly so for J≠0, and the means are shear-independent. Explicit independent-difference fourth moments give exactly the optimal curvature moduli, attained by quadratic tests. Concavity/convexity of z^(p/2) yields all p>0 cases. The collinear two-uniform endpoint follows from exact edge multiplicity. Standard-library code integrated independent samples in twelve rational configurations and checked both moment identities and phase reversals; no continuum claim rests on finite tests.
